COMMERCIAL CONTRACT
                                                                          No: WWN-RC/001/2024
                                                                             Date: 20th March 2024
THE SELLER: WUXI WANHONGNUO STAINLESS STEEL CO., LTD
Address: Room 660, Building B, 168 Qiangao Road, Liangxi District, Wuxi City, Jiangsu
Province, China.
Tel: 86-177-0151-0738                         Fax: 86-510-8307-5186
Represented by Mr. Johnny.
THE BUYER: N2 CO., LTD
Address: No. 1, Vo Van Ngan Street, Linh Chieu Ward, Thu Duc, Ho Chi Minh, Viet Nam.
Tel: 84-94-634-2370                    Fax: : 84-94-634-2370
Represented by Mr. Dan.
After discussing, it is mutually agreed by both parties to sign the commercial contract with terms
and conditions as following:
1/ Commodity – Quantity – Quality – Price
Commodity: Cold-rolled stainless steel sheet 310s 2B
Quantity: 23 100 kilograms/70 Pcs
Quality: Export Standard of Chinese
Price: 0,88 USD/Kg. CIF Cat Lai port, Viet Nam Incoterms 2020.
Total value: 20 328 USD
Say total: Twenty thousand three hundred and twenty eight - United States Dollar
2/ Specifications Packing:
Export standard packing with seaworthy wooden pallets, water proof paper, pvc film, interleaving
paper.
10 pieces of cold-rolled stainless steel sheet/package – 7 packages
3/ Quality: As export standard for manufacture, all 100% brand new.
4/ Shipping mark: Export standard marking.
5/ Payment – Documents Required:
Payment by TT at account of WUXI WANHONGNUO STAINLESS STEEL CO., LTD before
stuffing cargoes.
Bank account details:
Account name: WUXI WANHONGNUO STAINLESS STEEL CO., LTD
Bank name: Industrial & Commercial Bank of China (ICBC).
Account no: 0101000111902562381
Swift code: ICBKCNBJ
Documents required: Bill of lading, Packing list, Invoice, Certificate of Origin.
6/ Shipment:
Time of shipment: Before 15th April, 2024 and after date of contract
Shipment with ETA Ho Chi Minh city 8th April, 2024
Port of loading: ShangHai port
Port of discharging: Cat Lai port
Partial shipment: Not allowed
Transhipment: Allowed

7/ Insurance:
The Seller to be covered marine insurance for the Buyer’s rick of loss or damage to the goods
during the carriage at Bao Viet Insurance Company with 110% of invoice value covering ICC(A),
showing claim payable at Bao Viet Insurance Company, Ho Chi Minh city Branch in invoice
currency.
8/ Warranty:
The Seller warrants the good in a period of 12 months from the date of shipment. Any parts under
warranty clause are supplied free of charge on CIF Saigon Port within max 30 days from date of
claiming letter of the Buyer:
This warranty does not cover:
- Non compliance with direction for use.
- Loss of use of the product or consequential loss of any nature.
This warranty is valid only if the product is purchased and used in countries of Asia.
9/ Force majeure:
Neither the Seller nor Buyer is responsible for any delay in or cancellation of shipment and/or
delivery due to majeure, such as: strikes, fire, floods, war, riots, embargoes, earthquakes, including
but not limited to acts of God, restrictions or any conditions beyond the seller`s control. Force
majeure circumstances must be notified in writing by each party to other within 7 days and
confirmed a certificate of force majeure issued by Government authority. Beyond this time, force
majeure circumstances shall not be taken into consideration.
10/ Claim:
The Buyer has the right to make claim in writing to the Seller for quantity, quality according to the
Inspection Certificate of SGS within 30 days after receipt of the goods. Claim will be settled within
30 days from the date of receipt of the claim.
11/ Penalty:
To Cancellation of contract: Cancellation of this contract is not acceptable. If the Seller or the
Buyer wants to cancel the contracts, 3% of total contract value will be charged as penalty to that
party.
To Delay Shipment / Delay Payment: In case delay shipment/ delay payment happens, the penalty
for delay interest will be based on annual rate 6%.
12/ Arbitration:
All disputes arising from the execution of or in connection with this contract shall be settled through
friendly negotiation. In case no settlement can be reach through negotiation. The case International
Economic and Trade arbitration commission Shanghai commission for arbitration in accordance
with shall then be submitted to the Chinaits rules. The arbitral award is final and binding upon both
parties.
13/ General Conditions:
This contract is made in 04 English, 02 for each party of equal value. This contract comes into
effect from signing date to May 20, 2024, any amendment and additional clause to these conditions
shall be valid only if made in writing and sent by telex or fax and confirmed by both parties.
After 10 days from uneffected day, if two parties have no any dispute, this contract is become
liquidation.
     THE SELLER                                                       THE BUYER




   JOHNNY DANG                                                       LUU HUU DAN
